cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the ONLY ultimate party on wheels in the heart of Houston, Texas with our vibrant 15 ft open air party truck, the 1st of Houston's kind stationed in the historic 3rd Ward district.

We are your H-Town passport to the heartbeat of Houston's music, flavors, and kulture with a BYOB experience. Our open party truck is complete with a vibe host to keep your party going and is equipped with a cooler, ice & cups to keep your sips flowing! 

We're about to take you on a ride through 3rd Ward, EADO, and Midtown that'll have you vibing to Houston's music scene. 

You'll be the spotlight on the H-Town Streets as you vibe with friends, play a round of Hip Hop Bingo and dance to your hip hop & R&B favs! ! We welcome private groups for all events and occasions or meet new friends with our Public Ride!

Must be 21 and Up for Public Rides

Must be a min of 8 riders for the truck to roll out. If ride is cancelled for due to min not met you will receive a full refund. 

Let's Ride!!
